explication: Hermex is a native iPhone control client for a self-hosted Hermes agent; the server performs the computation and retains the agent’s data. The principal workflow is connecting and signing in, selecting or resuming a session, sending a configured message, then viewing its streamed response and tool activity. Other documented branches cover scheduled tasks, skills, workspace and Git browsing, memory and usage insights, and direct-Hermes Bot Mode. The graph uses README capabilities and paths in the tree; unsampled implementation details and wiring are not asserted.
